card.statement:
The extended twisted Yangian ${\mathscr{X}}^{\pm}_{N}$ of type AI/AII is the unital associative algebra with generators $s_{ij}^{(r)}$ , where $1\leqslant i,j\leqslant N$ and $r\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ , satisfying the quaternary relations (2.12), where $s_{ij}(u)$ is again given by (2.11).

2.3. Homomorphisms of (extended) twisted Yangians

In this subsection, we discuss various (anti)homomorphisms between (extended) twisted Yangians.

Let $\widetilde{S}(u)$ be the inverse of the generating matrix $S(u)$ :

(2.21)

$\displaystyle\widetilde{S}(u)=\big(\tilde{s}_{ij}(u)\big):=S(u)^{-1}.$

For $1\leqslant i\leqslant N$ , set

$\bar{i}=N+1-i.$

Then we have the following (anti)homomorphisms, see e.g. [Mol07, §2].

(1)

For any $m\in\mathbb{N}$ , we have the natural homomorphism $\jmath:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{m+N}^{\pm}$ defined by

$\jmath_{m}(s_{ij}(u))=s_{ij}(u).$

Here $m$ is even if $\mathfrak{g}_{N}=\mathfrak{sp}_{N}$ .

(2)

The map $\tau:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}$ defined by

$\tau(s_{ij}(u))=\theta_{i}\theta_{j}s_{j^{\prime}i^{\prime}}(u)$

is an anti-automorphism.

(3)

The map $\omega_{N}:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}$ defined by

$\omega_{N}(S(u))=\widetilde{S}(-u-\tfrac{N}{2})$

is an involution.

(4)

The map $\rho_{N}:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}$ defined by

$\rho_{N}(s_{ij}(u))=s_{\bar{i}\,\bar{j}}(u)$

is an isomorphism.

(5)

The map $\zeta_{N}:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}$ defined by

$\zeta_{N}=\rho_{N}\circ\omega_{N},\qquad s_{ij}(u)\mapsto\tilde{s}_{\bar{i}\,\bar{j}}(-u-\tfrac{N}{2})$

is an isomorphism.

(6)

For $m>0$ , there is a homomorphism $\varphi_{m}:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{m+N}^{\pm}$ given by shifting indices:

$\varphi_{m}(s_{ij}(u))=s_{m+i,m+j}(u).$

Then the map $\psi_{m}:{\mathscr{X}}_{N}^{\pm}\to{\mathscr{X}}_{m+N}^{\pm}$ defined by

$\psi_{m}=\omega_{m+N}\circ\varphi_{m}\circ\omega_{N}$

is a homomorphism. Here $m$ is even if $\mathfrak{g}_{N}=\mathfrak{sp}_{N}$ .

2.4. Sklyanin determinants and minors

We recall the definition of Sklyanin determinant and minors from [Mol07, Chap. 2.5–2.6].

Let $m\in\mathbb{N}$ be such that $m\leqslant N$ . We adopt the following abbreviation:

$u_{i}=u-i+1,\qquad S_{i}=S_{i}(u_{i}),\qquad i=1,2,\ldots,m.$

Let

$R_{ij}^T=R_{ji}^T=R_{ij}^T(-u_{i}-u_{j}), 1\leqslant i

Here we use the standard convention of subscripts to indicate the copies of $\mathbb{C}^{N}$ in $(\mathbb{C}^{N})^{\otimes m}$ it acts on, cf. [Mol07, Chap. 1.2]. Denote by $A_{m}$ the image of the anti-symmetrizer $\sum_{\sigma\in\mathfrak{S}_{m}}\text{sgn }\sigma\cdot\sigma$ under the natural action of $\mathfrak{S}_{m}$ on $(\mathbb{C}^{N})^{\otimes m}$ .

For an arbitrary permutation $(p_{1},p_{2},\ldots,p_{m})$ of the letters $1,2,\ldots,m$ , we denote by

$\langle S_{p_{1}},\ldots,S_{p_{m}}\rangle=S_{p_{1}}(R_{p_{1}p_{2}}^{\sf T}\ldots R_{p_{1}p_{m}}^{\sf T})S_{p_{2}}(R_{p_{2}p_{3}}^{\sf T}\ldots R_{p_{2}p_{m}}^{\sf T})\ldots S_{p_{m}}.$

Let $m=N$ . It is known that

(2.22)

$A_{N}\langle S_{1},\ldots,S_{N}\rangle=\langle S_{1},\ldots,S_{N}\rangle A_{N}.$

Since the image of the antisymmetrizer on $(\mathbb{C}^{N})^{\otimes N}$ is one-dimensional, the element (2.22) equals $A_{N}$ times a scalar series with coefficients in ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{\pm}$ .
card.label: Definition 2.8

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and finite $W$-algebras of classical type
paper.abstract: We introduce parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians of types AI and AII, interpolating between the R-matrix presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. Then we formulate and provide parabolic presentations for the shifted twisted Yangians. We define quotient algebras known as truncated shifted twisted Yangians and equip them with baby comultiplications, generalizing the work of Brundan and Kleshchev. PBW bases for all (truncated) shifted twisted Yangians of type AI and AII are established along the way. Applying the theory of universal equivariant quantizations of conic symplectic singularities we show that the truncated twisted shifted Yangian is isomorphic to the finite $W$-algebra which quantizes a suitable Slodowy slice. This provides a presentation of the finite $W$-algebra associated with every even nilpotent element in type {\sf B} and {\sf C}, as well as every nilpotent element with two Jordan blocks in type {\sf D}. Finally we make a conjecture which would supply presentations in the remaining even cases in type {\sf D}.
